verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance ships its own built-in AI feature, Compliance Navigator AI™, which provides regulatory guidance tailored to industry and location. That is a single marketing line describing advisory Q&A, not an assistant that takes delegated tasks and acts on them. Automated annual-report filing is rule-based automation rather than an AI assistant, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant can execute delegated actions (filing, record updates, license applications), documentation of its scope and workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
